ReLIFE is better than I was expecting it to be.

The premise is basically "Seventeen Again" the anime. The protagonist is struggling with life at 27, has no job, and no real life. He is recruited into an experiment and is given a drug that makes him appear 17 again, has his living expenses paid for a year, and has to attend the final year of high school again.

It's a really well done comedy drama thing. No perversion factor or fanservice at all here, the humor mostly revolves around how the characters interact with each other and stays away from juvenile or crass gags. It's just a very well done comedy with interesting characters that is genuinely funny and sweet. It's surprisingly well written and the drama moments are as strong as the humor elements.

It has a lot of heart and stays consistently entertaining and engaging. ReLIFE is well worth taking the time to check out.
